review_scope: Only PRs targeting this upstream repository. Metadata screening is not complete source review. Selected scopes are adapted, including one regression-only PR.
compatibility: No new dependency, font file, translation catalog, asset or contributor profile. Source/postimage helpers are fitted to current Node masks, single brush rename, thread.create and thumbnail UI. Version and parity scores unchanged.

deferred.cdr_3123: Open proposal; scoped new crate, parser boundaries, dependency/license/corpus and engine registration. About 6100 diff lines introduce a new untrusted-input importer; full compatibility, fuzzing and native file validation deferred. No CDR support added.
deferred.cdr_2890: Open competing import/export architecture, about5400 lines and UI/format/dependency changes. Deferred; no code copied.
deferred.save_export_3372_3481_3608: Depend on newer file-picker selected-type/extension replacement and overwrite-confirmation contracts absent here; defer together to avoid silent overwrite changes.
deferred.paragraph_3523_3537_3539: Depend on newer paragraph visitation/mixed-value helpers; no hyphenation-model expansion imported.
deferred.recolor_3476: Depends on newer modal row-height machinery; broader dialog compatibility deferred.
deferred.other: Large renderer, importer/backend, platform, docking, scripting and new-feature changes require separate compatibility passes. Interface translations, community/promotional/service integrations and publication changes excluded by owner scope.
